papers.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
papers.claim: Prefill/TTFT and decode/TPOT are distinct latency dimensions; co-location can create cross-phase interference.
papers.local_transfer: Phase-specific latency must be isolated. Multi-request/disaggregated-cluster scheduling results are not local evidence for single-request ArcLLM.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.claim: Chunked prefill and stall-free scheduling control prefill/decode interference in serving.
papers.local_transfer: Scheduling mechanism assumes serving batches/requests. Only the separation of prefill from decode is informative.

papers.title: DeepSpeed-FastGen: High-throughput Text Generation for LLMs via MII and DeepSpeed-Inference
papers.claim: Prompt and generation composition strategies change latency/throughput tradeoffs.
papers.local_transfer: Dynamic SplitFuse serving policy is not the single-request Vulkan mechanism under study.

external_source_pins.observed: Persistent vk_command_pool owns reusable command buffers; vk_pipeline_struct has initialized/compile state.
external_source_pins.note: Resource reuse is established Vulkan runtime practice; this does not establish local TTFT causality.

external_source_pins.observed: Chunked prefill is an explicit scheduler control.
external_source_pins.note: Multi-request scheduler mechanism differs from the frozen single-request ArcLLM path.

external_source_pins.observed: Prefill completion/first-output-token is measured separately from decode execution.

external_source_pins.note: Frozen ArcLLM W-S/W-C are fresh single requests with no cross-request prefix reuse.

external_source_pins.observed: Prefill wrappers separate planning from run-time execution.
external_source_pins.note: Plan/run separation is informative; CUDA-specific kernel performance is not transferable.

external_source_pins.observed: Source explicitly treats execution-plan finalization as potentially costly and separable from run.
external_source_pins.note: cuDNN/SM100 timing magnitudes are NOT_TRANSFERABLE to Intel Arc/Vulkan.

authoritative_vulkan_guidance.source: Khronos Vulkan Samples - Command buffer usage and multi-threaded recording
authoritative_vulkan_guidance.claim: Frequent command-buffer allocate/free has significant CPU overhead; pool/buffer reuse is preferred.
Pipeline creation may trigger expensive compilation; pipeline caches allow reuse of internal representations.
authoritative_vulkan_guidance.boundary: ArcLLM prepare_chain is outside measured TTFT, so only residual/deferred driver-state effects are admissible for this TTFT study.

exclusions.reason: Local source places anl64_build_plan before the TTFT t0 boundary.
Candidate and safe-reference build_prefill source is exact-equal and uses the same prefill shader family.
The parent frozen workloads are independent single-request executions with no shared-prefix cache contract.
Parent P6 compares isolated single-system cells rather than concurrent serving batches.

local_question_after_review: Residual TTFT mechanisms must arise inside the measured prefill/top2 interval or from pre-t0 state that causally changes that interval, despite identical prefill source.
